mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS id, b.specialist_id AS specialistId, u.full_name AS specialistName, sp.avatar_url AS specialistAvatar, sp.level AS specialistTitle, TIMESTAMP(ts.slot_date, ts.start_time) AS startTime, TIMESTAMP(ts.slot_date, ts.end_time) AS endTime, b.status AS status FROM bookings b JOIN time_slots ts ON b.slot_id = ts.id JOIN specialist_profiles sp ON b.specialist_id = sp.id JOIN users u ON sp.user_id = u.id WHERE b.customer_id = #{customerId} AND b.status = #{status} AND TIMESTAMP(ts.slot_date, ts.start_time) > #{currentTime} ORDER BY ts.slot_date ASC, ts.start_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT b.id AS id, u.full_name AS specialistName, sp.level AS specialistTitle, sp.avatar_url AS specialistAvatar, TIMESTAMP(ts.slot_date, ts.start_time) AS startTime, TIMESTAMP(ts.slot_date, ts.end_time) AS endTime, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, ts.start_time, ts.end_time) AS duration, b.price AS amount, b.status AS status, b.customer_notes AS remarks, b.created_at AS createdAt FROM bookings b JOIN time_slots ts ON b.slot_id = ts.id JOIN specialist_profiles sp ON b.specialist_id = sp.id JOIN users u ON sp.user_id = u.id WHERE b.id = #{bookingId} AND b.customer_id = #{customerId}

SELECT b.id AS id, u.full_name AS customerName, TIMESTAMP(ts.slot_date, ts.start_time) AS requestedStartTime, TIMESTAMP(ts.slot_date, ts.end_time) AS requestedEndTime, b.topic AS topic, b.created_at AS submissionTime FROM bookings b JOIN time_slots ts ON b.slot_id = ts.id JOIN users u ON b.customer_id = u.id JOIN specialist_profiles sp ON b.specialist_id = sp.id WHERE sp.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND b.status = #{status} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC

SELECT b.id AS id, u.full_name AS customerName, TIMESTAMP(ts.slot_date, ts.start_time) AS requestedStartTime, TIMESTAMP(ts.slot_date, ts.end_time) AS requestedEndTime, b.topic AS topic, b.created_at AS submissionTime, b.customer_notes AS customerNotes, CASE WHEN b.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN b.status = 'CANCELLED' AND b.rejection_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE b.status END AS status, b.decision_time AS decisionTime, b.rejection_reason AS rejectionReason FROM bookings b JOIN time_slots ts ON b.slot_id = ts.id JOIN users u ON b.customer_id = u.id JOIN specialist_profiles sp ON b.specialist_id = sp.id WHERE sp.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND b.decision_time IS NOT NULL AND ( b.status = 'CONFIRMED' OR (b.status = 'CANCELLED' AND b.rejection_reason IS NOT NULL) ) ORDER BY b.decision_time DESC, b.created_at DESC

SELECT b.id AS id, u.full_name AS customerName, TIMESTAMP(ts.slot_date, ts.start_time) AS requestedStartTime, TIMESTAMP(ts.slot_date, ts.end_time) AS requestedEndTime, b.topic AS topic, b.created_at AS submissionTime, b.customer_notes AS customerNotes, CASE WHEN b.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN b.status = 'CANCELLED' AND b.rejection_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE b.status END AS status, b.decision_time AS decisionTime, b.rejection_reason AS rejectionReason FROM bookings b JOIN time_slots ts ON b.slot_id = ts.id JOIN users u ON b.customer_id = u.id JOIN specialist_profiles sp ON b.specialist_id = sp.id WHERE b.id = #{bookingId} AND sp.user_id = #{currentUserId} LIMIT 1
